description: Re-execute the missing-local-range Delta history under C_snapshot_preservation, alongside a Complete control. A unique case name correlates initial prefix, selected source history, generated sync delivery and final export. Compare receiver history to the actual source history observed before reconnect, independently of receiver output.

harness.description: Public API integration test; no private state injection. Records preconditions and actual message contents; drains controlled network work and exports decisions through read_decided_suffix.
semantic_changes: Test-defined Entry and concatenating Snapshot; JSON event instrumentation and explicit network partition scheduling only.
Ordered vector observations are encoded as JSON strings for scalar comparison.

legality.derivation: Build three validated public OmniPaxos instances with fresh MemoryStorage; manually attempt leader 1, drain all generated messages; optionally decide value 11 on every replica. Temporarily disconnect node 3 and discard its link traffic while quorum 1/2 decides 22. After healing call reconnected(1) at node 3, a documented caller notification of a re-established connection, then deliver all generated messages. No target code or message fields are changed. All work runs synchronously and the test drops its in-memory nodes after exporting results. No timer deadline is claimed; finite operations finish between periodic ticks.
legality.applicability: Three noncrashed nodes in configuration 1 with default batch size, successful MemoryStorage operations, and a temporary node-3 link partition followed by reconnected(1).
alternatives: Complete-snapshot control has initial prefix length zero.

grounding.derivation: Apply C_snapshot_preservation to the observed source decided prefix and receiver export after delivery of a real synchronization. Concatenating History matches the repository ValueSnapshot semantics. Exact vector encoding preserves ordering and multiplicity.
grounding.applicability: Three noncrashed nodes in configuration 1 with default batch size, successful MemoryStorage operations, and a temporary node-3 link partition followed by reconnected(1).
alternatives: Complete-snapshot control has initial prefix length zero.

observable_properties.description: After admitted synchronization completes, the receiver decided-prefix representation equals the previously observed selected source decided prefix.

uncertainties: Only the captured same-ballot reconnect schedule and MemoryStorage are measured.
Other snapshot implementations, persistent recovery and later application processing are not checked.
